symptom: `alter page M.P { add parameters $X: … }` then a show page passing X, in one script: check --references and exec refused it with `page M.P has no parameter "X"`; the same statements as two scripts ran (mendixlabs/mxcli#1736)
cause: the script pre-pass recorded page parameter names only from create page, so for an altered page the show page argument check fell through to the stored parameter list
file: mdl/executor/validate.go (collectDefinitions AlterPageStmt case, pageParamEdits), mdl/executor/validate_show_page_params.go (recordPageParamEdits, applyPageParamEdits); test validate_show_page_params_alter_test.go
insight: A script-context index that only listens to create statements reads every alter as a no-op — the same class as the #1355 script-set fix, one level down. Record the alter's edits rather than a computed list, because the pre-pass has no project to read the stored list from; apply them over whichever list wins at lookup time. End-to-end on PedApp 11.13.0: the base build refuses with the reported message, the fix passes check and exec writes both. Control: without the pre-pass case, the add/drop/create-then-alter subtests fail.
